title: Fidelity map and component contrast guidelines for console primitives
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Context: As we continue to scale console surfaces (dashboards, rollout rails, and cost visualizations), inconsistent component fidelity and insufficient contrast between token variants cause developer confusion and accessibility drift. This ticket captures the work to produce a fidelity map (visual continuum for low→high fidelity usages), a companion contrast guideline for color/token application across densities, and a compact reference page in the Figma library. Goals: 1) Define three fidelity tiers (skeleton, compact, high-fidelity) with explicit token mappings and allowed component states; 2) Produce contrast rules for primary, secondary, accent, and status tokens at each tier, with WCAG target levels and exception rules for microcopy and data sparkline overlays; 3) Publish a Figma page + ready-to-use component variants for console cards, rails, chips, and rollout controls; 4) Run a 1-week design consistency review with PMs and engineering to validate feasibility and update implementation notes. Out of scope: New pattern introductions (e.g., new chart types) and full migration of legacy surfaces — those will be separate tickets. Deliverables: - Figma page: Fidelity Map & Contrast Guidelines (prototype and component variants) - Markdown spec in Design Drive (contrast tables, token reference, CSS token names) - Implementation notes for frontend: expected CSS variables, accessibility tests, and a migration checklist for affected routes - Short rollout plan for incremental adoption (canary pages, review checkpoints)
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains fidelity map artboards and at least one verified variant per primitive (card, chip, rail, button, pill)
Contrast table enumerates token pairings for the three fidelity tiers with WCAG AA/AAA pass/fail annotations
Design Drive spec includes mapping to token names used by frontend (token key examples and recommended overrides)
Engineering review sign-off recorded in comments with any feasibility constraints noted
A migration checklist and phased rollout plan are attached and scheduled with PMs for console-2026.03
